features.name: Integral numeric arithmetic and ordering promotion
features.scope: Byte/Short arithmetic and unary results promote to Int; mixed integral arithmetic and comparisons promote to Long when either operand is Long; existing floating operand promotion is regression-tested
restrictions: No implicit assignment narrowing or new integral equality/bitwise conversions

features.name: ShortArray representation and operations
features.scope: Construction, stable initializer lambdas, indexing, signed 16-bit writes/reads, iteration, primitive varargs and spread, ordinary library factories, Java and Kotlin metadata contracts
restrictions: Effectful initializer-producing expressions retain the existing explicit specification/oracle evaluation-order rejection boundary.

Inherited import-resolution boundary: an explicit alias of a default-imported function and its original implicit name do not freely coexist in one source file; positive alias and original-name checks use separate source files.
Short annotation elements, const declarations, complete standard library APIs, Android/full-app compatibility and performance are not claimed.
